newsitem.title: INDIA: Alcatel's India partner launches telephone systems.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel's India partner launches telephone systems.

text.p: Alcatel Business Systems India Private Ltd (ABSI), a joint venture of France's Alcatel Business Systems International and United Telecoms Ltd of India, on Wednesday announced the launch of their telephone terminals in India.
"Our target is to provide international quality and the latest technology at competitive prices to Indian customers," Arnaud Soubelet, ABSI's chief operating officer told a news conference.
Alcatel Business Systems International, which focusses on emerging markets, is a part of French telecommunication giant Alcatel Alsthom.
ABSI is presently manufacturing, marketing and servicing the Alcatel 4000 series of digital EPABX, key telephone terminals and voice processing systems.
"We have brought in the latest international technology for desk telephone terminals for the Indian market," said ABSI's Soubelet.

The Indian joint venture is targetting a turnover of 400 million rupees in calendar 1998, Soubelet said. He estimated the Indian market for telephone terminals at about 1.5 million terminals and expected annual growth rate of 30 percent.
